days.title: Northern Lake and Visitor Center
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kävsjön
stops.detail: The wetlands around Lake Kävsjön are breeding grounds for about 100 bird species in summer, including swans, herons, ducks, geese, and cranes.

stops.name: Kävsjön runt
stops.detail: The Kävsjön runt circles Lake Kävsjön over a total length of 14 kilometers.

stops.name: Svartgölsleden
stops.detail: It runs in the northern part of the park, as do the 4-kilometer-long Östra Rockne runt and the 3.5 km Svartgölsleden.

days.title: Southern Bogs and Islands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Stora Gungflyet
stops.detail: In the southeastern part of the lake lies the approximately two-kilometer-long and one-kilometer-wide quaking bog Stora Gungflyet.

stops.name: Kittlakull
stops.detail: The house Kittlakull formerly served as the residence for the manager of the peat industry; directly behind the railway line that runs through the moor, ruins of the old peat mining sites can still be found there.

stops.name: Lilla Lövö
stops.detail: An island in the southwestern part of the moor is Lilla Lövö.

stops.name: Blådöpet runt
stops.detail: Likewise, the Lövö runt, the Blådöpet runt, and the Andersberg-Kvarnaberget-Lövö path with lengths of 3.6, 5.2, and 7.5 kilometers can be [walked].
